questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: For mig var landet vigtigt. Jeg valgte at tage til Bologna i Italien, som er en meget studievenlig by.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Virkelig godt ophold. Jeg kan anbefalde Bologna som destination. God by hvis man gerne vil ud at rejse i Italien da det ligger meget centralt med godt tognet.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var lidt en udfordring - men jeg havde venner at spare med. Hvis du kender nogen der skal afsted så tag kontakt til dem så I kan være flere om at notere deadlines osv.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ikke andet end at jeg havde hørt godt om byen - Bologna.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Det var svært at få hurtigt svar på mails og spørgsmål i Italien så det skal man lige være klar over.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg fandt en lejlighed på SpotAHome - det er en anbefalingsværdigt. Pas på med at finde noget på Facebook eller andet uden sikkerhed, jeg har hørt om mange der bliver scammet. Vær ude i god tid, jeg fandt en lejlighed 4 mdr. før jeg skulle afsted.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det kommer an på destinationen. I Bologna er Campus over det hele i byen så der er det slet ikke et problem, men hvis man skal et andet sted hen så kan det være andeledes.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det er lidt dyrt og ikke stort udbud, så vær ude i god tid.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var lidt besværligt - men det hele værd.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Vær opmærksom på at hvis du tager afsted på Bachelor kan kun vælge BA fra host universitetets side, jeg endte med at sende mange ubrugelige forhåndsgodkendelser på KA fag. Man skal have en mail til host univesitetes 'Absalon', som hedder Virtuale, som man skal bruge meget.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Hvis man er i tvivl så ring eller skriv mail til kontaktpersonerne.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det var ok. Det tog lang tid, fordi det var svært at finde fag jeg kunne tag (både i Bologna men også ift. valgfag og prioriteret valgfag). Det er meget normalt at 'der går noget galt' og at man først finder ud af hvilke fag man tager når man er et par uge inde i opholdet - så stress ikke hvis det ikke lige går som planlagt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Følg det der står på Mobility Online, og send forhåndsgodkendelser i god tid, og undersøg at du kan tage faget i host landet (fx. kan du ikke tage KA fag hvis du er indskrevet som BA-studerende).

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
Jeg havde disse fire fag som økonomistuderende 
- Principles of Management (1. års kursus, så ikke så svært)
- Industrial Organization (Mikro-agtigt kursus, fin sværhedsgrad)
- Apple Political Sociology (fag på sociologi. Udveksling er en virkelig god mulighed for at tage fag på andre fakulteter så det vil jeg anbefale.)
- Monetray Economics (Forlæseren havde en meget tyk accent så jeg havde lidt svært ve at forstå hvad hun sagde)

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer:
Ikke lige så gode slides. 
Lavere niveau og generelt mindre arbejdsbyrde.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

Eller ikke noget uforventet

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Maden er ret billig i Bologna, så man kan tage ud at spise på Osteria

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
Sport (fitness) er dyr i Bologna, så jeg løb bare ture. 
Der ligger en skakklub lidt uden for byen, så det kan anbefales.
Yoga er også dyrt men nice.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Yoga tilbydes ti en billige pris, men det var i en gymnastiksal så ikke noget for mig. Samme med fitness.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Der er masse aktiviteter med andre udvekslingsstuderende, og ellers skak og yoga, restaurant.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tage på ture. Var selv i Genova, Mailano, Firenze, Napoli, Venedig, og det er bare en virkelig god mulighed for at komme ud og se noget mere.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Ret nemt, det hele går lidt langsommere men det er også meget hyggeligt. Ikke stol på transporten.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: gør det i starten, folk finder hurtigt hinanden så det er godt at vær med fra starten

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: tempo

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: maden, vinen og arkitekturen

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Nyd det, og bo inde for bymuren - det er ret fedt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Find lejlighed i god tid
Man kan gå rundt i hele byen fordi den ikke er så stor.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: kulturen, og bare det at være i et andet land i et semester

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer:
Have en hverdag i en anden kultur - men det er også fedt. 
Det praktiske var lidt udfordrende, men man klarer det.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
